stories.title: UAE Reaffirms Full Solidarity with Saudi Arabia Following Houthi Attacks

en.title: UAE Reaffirms Full Solidarity with Saudi Arabia Following Houthi Attacks
en.summary: The UAE has expressed complete solidarity with Saudi Arabia in response to Houthi attacks against the kingdom.

stories.title: UAE condemns Houthi attack on Saudi airport, backs Kingdom’s security measures

en.title: UAE condemns Houthi attack on Saudi airport, backs Kingdom's security measures
en.summary: The UAE Foreign Minister condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, including strikes on King Khalid International Airport, and pledged support for Saudi security actions.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia to outpace global growth with 7.9% expansion in 2027: IMF

en.title: Saudi Arabia to outpace global growth with 7.9% expansion in 2027: IMF
en.summary: The International Monetary Fund projects Saudi Arabia's economy will expand by 7.9 percent in 2027, more than double the global growth rate, supported by diversified energy exports.

stories.title: Al-Nassr rebound from Al-Ain hammering with AFC Champions League win against Neftchi

en.title: Al-Nassr rebound from Al-Ain hammering with AFC Champions League win against Neftchi
en.summary: Al-Nassr recovered from a 4-0 defeat with a 3-1 victory over Neftchi in AFC Champions League play, though kickoff was delayed due to a civil defense alert.

stories.title: Trump says Houthis are ‘misbehaving very badly’ following attacks on Saudi Arabia

en.title: Trump says Houthis are 'misbehaving very badly' following attacks on Saudi Arabia
en.summary: US President Donald Trump criticized Yemen's Houthis for escalating missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia, including strikes on King Khalid International Airport, but provided no details on potential US response measures.

stories.title: Russia Says Its Diesel Exports May Exceed Volumes Announced by Trump

en.title: Russia Says Its Diesel Exports May Exceed Volumes Announced by Trump
en.summary: Russia indicated that its diesel export volumes could surpass the amounts previously announced by Trump.

stories.title: Al-Dossary: Saudi Arabia is prepared to deal with any emergency situation

en.title: Al-Dossary: Saudi Arabia is prepared to deal with any emergency situation
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Media Minister praised security forces for defending against Houthi attacks on civilians and infrastructure, affirming the kingdom's commitment to maintaining security and continuing development priorities.

stories.title: UN Human Rights Chief condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi airports

en.title: UN Human Rights Chief condemns Houthi attacks on Saudi airports
en.summary: The UN Human Rights Commissioner condemned repeated Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabian airports, noting that such actions violate international humanitarian law and calling for investigation and accountability.

stories.title: Islamic leaders condemn deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia that threaten safety of pilgrims

en.title: Islamic leaders condemn deadly Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia that threaten safety of pilgrims
en.summary: Religious and political leaders from 176 countries condemned Houthi attacks in Riyadh that killed 12 and wounded 309, expressing concern about threats to pilgrims visiting Islam's holiest sites.

stories.title: FMs of UK, Bahrain call Prince Faisal to reaffirm solidarity with Saudi Arabia

en.title: FMs of UK, Bahrain call Prince Faisal to reaffirm solidarity with Saudi Arabia
en.summary: Foreign ministers from the United Kingdom and Bahrain contacted Saudi Arabia's Foreign Minister to condemn Houthi attacks on King Khalid International Airport and express solidarity with Saudi Arabia and Yemen's government.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia will overcome challenges, uphold global energy commitments, Prince Abdulaziz says

en.title: Saudi Arabia will overcome challenges, uphold global energy commitments, Prince Abdulaziz says
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's Energy Minister stated that the nation will meet its international energy obligations and advance its transformation agenda despite recent regional challenges and infrastructure attacks.

stories.title: Saudi Arabia extends suspension of operations at Riyadh airport following Houthi attacks

en.title: Saudi Arabia extends suspension of operations at Riyadh airport following Houthi attacks
en.summary: Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority extended the suspension of operations at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh following Houthi attacks. The extension allows time for safety inspections and verification of airport facilities before resuming operations.

stories.title: ‎RCRC signs contracts to purchase 94 new trains; deliveries to begin in 2028

en.title: RCRC signs contracts to purchase 94 new trains; deliveries to begin in 2028
en.summary: The Royal Commission for Riyadh City has contracted to purchase 94 new trains, expanding the metro fleet from 183 to 277 trains with deliveries starting in 2028. The expansion will increase passenger capacity by 57% across the network.

en.title: Tadawul sees 7 negotiated deals worth SAR 55.1M
en.summary: The Saudi Exchange recorded seven negotiated deals totaling SAR 55.1 million on October 13, involving shares of companies including Bupa Arabia, Al Rajhi Bank, Mobily, and others traded at negotiated prices separate from regular market rates.

en.title: Watani Steel hits 52-week peak
en.summary: Watani Steel shares reached their highest price in 52 weeks on October 13, trading at SAR 3.21 and gaining 76% since transferring from the parallel market to the main market the previous week.

en.title: TASI: 7 stocks, 1 REIT fall to 52-week lows
en.summary: Seven TASI-listed companies and Jadwa REIT Saudi reached their lowest prices in 52 weeks on October 13, with declines ranging from 20% to 73% over the period.

en.title: SMC, Nahdi fall to all-time lows
en.summary: Two Saudi-listed stocks reached their lowest prices since their market debuts on October 13. SMC has declined 29 percent year-to-date since listing in June 2025, while Nahdi has fallen 27 percent since its March 2022 listing.
